* chore(shell): remove zellij and zjstatus (#1949)

Implements plan/2026-09-22-1949-remove-zellij.md. zellij was unused but
still wired in at every layer, and its tmate dependency broke razer's
evaluation when nixpkgs marked tmate insecure.

Removed: the home/shell/zellij module and layouts, the
features.multiplexers.zellij option and its 8 setters, the zjstatus
flake input, overlay and stub module, the bare zellij packages, and the
docs and tool-config mentions. tmux, herdr and tuios are untouched.

flake.lock is pruned with nix flake lock only: 6 nodes removed, no rev
added or moved. The plan said 5; flake-utils' private systems node is
the sixth, and the plan is corrected in this commit.
